elements_selected.content: Refactor hook.py to use the shared session module. (1) After passing gates and importing sense_mcp, import session module. (2) Load shared state via session.load(). (3) Replace hook's own surfaced_files tracking: use shared state surfaced counts for dedup weighting instead of the hook's binary seen/unseen list. (4) After filtering results, call session.record_surfaced() and session.record_query(), then session.save(). (5) Move cooldown (last_query_time) into shared state — session.last_query_time replaces the hook's own state file. (6) Remove hook's get_state_path(), load_state(), save_state() functions and the /tmp/sense-auto-query-*.json files. (7) The hook still opens SQLite read-only for chunk data — only session state uses the shared JSON file.
Modified 6 files (+331, -117): sense_mcp/hook.py, sense_mcp/server.py, sense_mcp/session.py, tests/conftest.py, tests/test_mode_retrieval.py and 1 more
